notes: Primary initiative: migrate from in-house ANN + tensorflow-based reranker to Redwood embeddings + learned reranker for enterprise search (RAG).
Scale constraints: currently indexing ~50M documents, expect 10-20% quarterly growth. Concern about embedding storage footprint and recall latency under heavy concurrency.
Latency targets: 95th percentile < 180ms for vector lookup + reranker on dedicated pool; P50 target < 90ms. Throughput target: sustained 120 qps, burst to 400 qps.
Cost sensitivity: CXO wants cost per query to be <= $0.003 at scale vs current $0.0045 (includes ANN infra + CPU reranker).

Model preferences: prefer open models for embeddings (local quantized) but open to Redwood-verified variants. Reranker: BERT-small -> candidate for migration to a distilled cross-encoder maintained by Redwood.

Evals-driven migration: customer insists on test harness with labeled query set (12k queries) + scenario-based regression thresholds. Will require A/B and canary rollouts and automatic regression alerts.
QA concerns: 'We can't afford drops in mean reciprocal rank on enterprise queries' — product lead stressed need for rollback policy and per-query monitoring.
Operational asks: per-route token/cost telemetry, token-level tracing for contested queries, and support for hot/cold index tiers to reduce storage costs.
Security/Compliance: must support SSO/SAML, KMS integration for key separation, and exportable audit logs for two-year retention. Data residency gating for EU customers.
POC plan (agreed): 2-week 'apples-to-apples' eval — Redwood serves embeddings + reranker in dedicated VPC; we run blind A/B on 10% traffic for 3 days and canary rollouts for reranker model families.
Stated blockers: procurement requires cost model for 24 months; legal needs proof of EU residency; SE needs to validate latency at 400 qps burst with realistic doc sizes.
